title: Design Studio Selections Addendum — Choice of Package and Package Changes
content:
These clauses govern which Design Studio Selections package a file may carry and how the package of a file may be changed.

**Clause 1 — Eligible package.** A package may be chosen only for a purchase agreement whose collection is listed among the package's eligible collections.

**Clause 2 — Changing package.** The package may be changed while the file is awaiting appointment or in selection. Moving up carries the new package's package upgrade fee as a package fee option line. Moving down is allowed only where the current package permits a move to a lower package.

**Clause 3 — State of the file.** A package change is written only on a file whose status is awaiting appointment or in selection. The status that decides is the status of that same file in Calloway's records at the time of the change.

**Clause 4 — Allowance on a change.** On a change the package allowance already granted is replaced by the new package's allowance less any allowance already applied, never below zero.

**Clauses 2 and 3 as a table**

| File status | Move up | Move down |
|---|---|---|
| Awaiting appointment | Permitted; new package's upgrade fee booked as a package fee option line | Permitted only where the current package permits a move down |
| In selection | Permitted; new package's upgrade fee booked as a package fee option line | Permitted only where the current package permits a move down |
| Structural closed, finalized, delivered or cancelled | Not written | Not written |

**Clause 4 worked on hypothetical figures**

- Allowance granted 1500.00, of which 400.00 already applied; the new package's allowance is 3000.00. The allowance granted is replaced by 3000.00 less 400.00, that is 2600.00.
- Allowance granted 3000.00, of which 2000.00 already applied; the new package's allowance is 1500.00. 1500.00 less 2000.00 is below zero, so the allowance granted is replaced by 0.00.

**Questions answered by the clauses**

*May a package be chosen for an agreement in a collection the package does not list?* No; Clause 1 limits the choice to the listed collections.

*Which package's figure decides whether a move down is open?* The package the file is in before the move (the current package).
